features.notes: play.predictOffer stages offer+ask on a copy of the pure state (same ids, seed, request, reaction, signature); prefetchCandidates (bridge/chooser only, idle crew, --prefetch 0..5 default 2); native_watch prefetch keeps a reserve of 3 attempts, skips saved/known words, never shows prefetches as replies; an offer made mid-prefetch adopts the job. async-test scenarios 6-7 pass; prefetch leaves domain records unchanged.
